 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-aee23c6a.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]

    target = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r, _ in target), max(r for r, _ in target)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for _, c in target), max(c for _, c in target)

    obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] not in (0, background)]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in obj), max(r for r, _ in obj)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in obj), max(c for _, c in obj)
    pattern = [grid[r][c0:c1 + 1] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    mirrored = [row[::-1] for row in pattern]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr, row in enumerate(mirrored):
        for dc, value in enumerate(row):
            out[tr0 + dr][tc0 + dc] = value
    return out
PY
